summary: Bit Origin Ltd (BTOG) filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release on its acquisition of 16 NVIDIA Blackwell B300 AI servers with related contractual rights for $1M cash and $10M in equity, closed June 28, 2026. The board recommends the deal as a balance-sheet strengthening move. No advisor is named. The transaction is expected to support AI computing operations after delivery in Q3 2026 and helps Bit Origin meet Nasdaq equity minimum of $2.5M. Watch for delivery timing and any Nasdaq compliance updates as the accounting treatment is finalized.
